title: Fixed Open Comb and Over-Cavity Grip Berry Scoop
description: One newly authored complete empty hand-held berry-comb scoop appearance. A whole deep open collecting floor/back and two high rising cheeks receive a single connected front comb plate with nine blunt elongated teeth and true deep slots. A longitudinal over-cavity arch grip joins a narrow front cross seat and the high rear wall. Not a long-pole crown cup, hooded long-handled dustpan, or picking bin with more containers. All geometry newly drawn, no imported old meshes. One static model zero scenes; no berries, harvesting action, cutting, food suitability, ergonomics, load, plant compatibility or use safety claim.
